blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Office of the Ombudsman will conduct unannounced inspections at the New Quezon City Jail in Payatas following reports that detained former House Speaker Martin Romualdez was escorted out of his dormitory by a jail warden. Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla announced the planned inspections on Friday, Nov. 6, warning that Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) personnel found violating jail rules could face dismissal. “To remove any doubt about how things are doing, we will do surprise visits at jail… We’ll visit Payatas, once in a while, at any given hour, whether it be morning or it’s […]...
